# Dr. Prema N. – Consultant Obstetrician & Gynaecologist, Coimbatore

> Website: https://drpremagynaecologistcbe.in/

## About Dr. Prema N.

Dr. Prema N. is a Consultant Obstetrician and Gynaecologist based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India.

Qualifications:
- MBBS
- MS (Obstetrics & Gynaecology)
- DGO
- DNB (Obstetrics & Gynaecology)
- FICOG – Fellow of the Indian College of Obstetricians & Gynaecologists

Professional profile:
- Over 20 years of experience in women's healthcare.
- Consultant Obstetrician and Gynaecologist at Kovai Medical Center & Hospital, Coimbatore.
- Professor at KMCH Institute of Health Sciences & Research (previous academic position).
- Two university gold medals.
- Professional memberships include FOGSI, IMA and Tamil Nadu Medical Council.

Clinical special interests:
- High-risk pregnancy management.
- Vaginal Birth After Caesarean (VBAC).
- Normal delivery and natural birthing.
- Bio-mimic birthing.
- Waterbirthing and labour hydrotherapy.
- No Scar Vaginal Hysterectomy (NOVA).
- Advanced laparoscopic gynaecological surgery.
- Fertility and reproductive medicine.

## Specialised Expertise

### High-Risk Pregnancy Specialist in Coimbatore
Dr. Prema provides clinical care and monitoring for pregnancies requiring specialised obstetric attention.

### VBAC Specialist in Coimbatore
Provides assessment and counselling for eligible women considering vaginal birth after a previous caesarean delivery.

### Natural Birthing in Coimbatore
Supports physiological and natural birthing approaches when medically appropriate.

### Gynaecologist for PCOS in Coimbatore
Provides evaluation and individualised management for polycystic ovary syndrome and related hormonal concerns.

### Fertility Treatment in Coimbatore
Provides fertility evaluation and treatment guidance for women and couples experiencing difficulty conceiving.

### No-Scar Vaginal Hysterectomy in Coimbatore
Offers specialised assessment for vaginal hysterectomy and other appropriate surgical approaches.
